rows.grounds: anaphoric pronoun referring to the previously described person
compound denoting duties pertaining to birth or caste
refers to relatives or family members

items.question: What sovereign role does this fearless person hold regarding caste duties and kinsmen?
premises: The subject is the previously described fearless person.
He is the agent of caste duties.
He is the lord of kinsmen.
items.inference: Therefore this person holds sovereign authority over social and familial obligations.
uncertainties: The precise scope of jāti+dharmāṇāṃ as birth-based or caste-based duties is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: He is indeed the doer of the duties of caste and the lord of kinsmen.
